newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-DETTORI BACK ON GROUP ONE WINNING TRAIL.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-DETTORI BACK ON GROUP ONE WINNING TRAIL.

text.p: Frankie Dettori, still on the crest of wave, won the group one Middle Park Stakes on Thursday, riding 7-4 favourite Bahamian Bounty for trainer David Loder.
Bahamian Bounty, hugging the rails, edged out 16-1 chance Muchea, the mount of Richard Hughes, to grab the $127,600 first prize by a head.

The Middle Park, raced over six furlongs (1.2 km), is seen as a trial for next year's classic colts and Loder was reasonably confident Bahamian Bounty, whose sire was a sprinter, would stay the extra two furlongs (400 metres) of the 2,000 Guineas.
"He has such a relaxed way of racing, it could well be within his compass," the trainer said.
Dettori's seven winners at Ascot last Saturday included a group one success in the Queen Elizabeth 11 Stakes on Mark of Esteem.
